action.objective: Commit Kc8 as the verified drawing attempt, keeping the king near the b-pawn and off the back-rank mating net.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search over both legal moves gave Kc8 exact -590 vs Ka8 exact -616, and Kc8 passed single-candidate verification at depth 4 with complete immediate-mate safety, no tactical refutation, and no checking-chain mate. It is the sole commit_ready move. The position is lost either way, but Kc8 keeps the b7 pawn and king connected for the best practical promotion/draw chances.
